title: Forgot Your BVN? How to Recover, Check and Print It
excerpt: Learn how to retrieve a forgotten BVN with the registered phone number, what to do without the old SIM, and how to obtain a printable slip safely.

sections.content: If you forgot your 11-digit Bank Verification Number, start with the phone number registered to the BVN. NIBSS says you can dial *565*0# from that line to retrieve the number. If you cannot access the registered line, recover the SIM from the mobile network where possible or visit your bank with valid identification.

Retrieving the number, changing the phone number linked to it, and printing a BVN slip are different tasks. The USSD route retrieves an existing BVN; it does not modify the record. A bank or another authorised institution must verify supported corrections. A slip service can generate an available printable format after you already have the correct number.

A BVN slip can help you review the identity details returned for the number or provide a printable record when an organisation requests one. Available layouts differ, and not every format includes the same fields or a photograph. A printed slip does not replace live verification when a bank or other institution requires it.

Treat a BVN and its slip as sensitive identity information. Use the NIBSS-published retrieval route, your bank, or a service whose price, purpose, privacy terms, and support channel you can verify. Never share a banking PIN or one-time password, and delete copies left on a shared phone, browser, or print-shop computer.
The sections below show the registered-line route, the lost-SIM route, safe printing steps, and what to do when a bank still needs to link or refresh the record.

sections.content: Simple Ways to Find Your Forgotten BVN Number
If you forgot your BVN, try these simple recovery methods before visiting a branch:

items: Dial the official USSD code: NIBSS says to dial *565*0# from the phone number registered to the BVN. Its published service fee is ₦20; confirm the prompt before proceeding.

Check your bank's authenticated channels: Some banks display a masked or complete BVN in the profile area or provide a retrieval option. Availability differs by bank, so use only its official app, website, USSD code, or support line.
Visit your bank: If digital retrieval is unavailable, ask the bank what identification it accepts for an in-person BVN lookup.

sections.content: How to Retrieve Your BVN Without the Registered Phone Number

The NIBSS USSD route requires the phone number registered to the BVN. If the SIM is lost but the number still belongs to you, ask the mobile network whether it can issue a replacement SIM with the same number. After the line is restored, use *565*0# from that line.

If the old line cannot be recovered, visit a bank where you hold an account and complete its identity-verification process. Take an accepted government ID, your NIN if requested, the linked account number, and any BVN enrolment record you still have. The bank can help identify the existing BVN without creating a second enrolment.

items: Retrieval reveals the existing BVN; it does not change the phone number attached to it.
A phone-number update is a separate controlled process and may require additional evidence.
Do not use a website that claims it can search the BVN database from only a name and date of birth.
Never give an OTP, bank password, card PIN, or CVV to someone offering recovery help.
Once the number is recovered, use a slip service only if you actually need a printable document.

sections.content: Querying and Printing Your BVN Slip on Ufriends IT
Once you have recovered the 11 digits, you can use Ufriends IT to generate and download a clean PDF slip:

steps.title: Access the Dashboard
steps.content: Log into your Ufriends account and review the current BVN slip options. Fund the wallet using an available method, confirm the displayed charge, and wait for the balance to update before submitting.

steps.title: Select Print BVN Slip
steps.content: Open the NIN and BVN slip section and select the BVN slip format that matches the document you need.

steps.title: Input BVN Details
steps.content: Enter only the identifier requested by the selected service. Check every digit before continuing and do not enter a banking PIN or OTP.

steps.title: Download and Print PDF
steps.content: Review the order summary and submit it. When the result is available, inspect the name, BVN, date of birth, and photograph where included before saving or printing the PDF. Use the order reference if support is needed.

sections.content: Understanding the Visual Security Features of Your Slip

BVN slip layouts can vary by service and format. Check that the name, number, date of birth, and photograph—when the selected format includes one—belong to the correct person and remain readable. A printed layout does not replace a live BVN verification when the receiving organisation requires one. Never edit the PDF to change an identity field.
When Ufriends Can Help With a BVN Slip

Ufriends is useful after you have recovered the correct BVN and need a traceable way to generate a printable slip. It should not be used as a substitute for bank identity verification when you do not know the number or cannot access the registered line. Compare available formats in the BVN slip PDF guide. If the registered line must change, follow the separate lost-SIM and BVN phone-update guide.

items: Choose the right service: Use retrieval through NIBSS or your bank when you do not know the number; use Ufriends when you know the BVN and need an available slip format.
See the live price: Sign in and review the current format and fee before submitting.
Inspect the result: Confirm every displayed identity field before downloading or printing.
Keep a traceable order: Save the Ufriends transaction reference and use the official support channel if the output is incorrect.
Protect the PDF: Store it securely and delete copies left on a shared computer or print-shop device.

sections.content: Linking Your Recovered BVN to Your Bank Profile

To link a recovered BVN to another bank account, follow that bank's official app, website, USSD, support, or branch process. The bank may compare the identity details on the account with the BVN record and request evidence when they do not match. Retrieving the number alone does not guarantee that a restriction will be removed.
Common Mistakes to Avoid During Recovery

items: Sharing Details on Social Media: Scammers look for users posting 'I forgot my BVN' online to trick them. Only use verified portals.
Entering a wrong number: A typographical error can return no result or the wrong order outcome. Double-check every digit before paying.
Using an unregistered line for USSD retrieval: NIBSS says *565*0# must be dialled from the phone number registered to the BVN. Use the bank-assisted route if that line is unavailable.

sections.content: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

items: What is the official BVN retrieval code? NIBSS publishes *565*0# for retrieval from the phone number registered to the BVN.
Can I retrieve a BVN without the old SIM? Recover the same line through the network if possible. Otherwise, visit your bank with accepted identification.

Can Ufriends discover a BVN when I know neither the number nor registered phone? Use your bank's identity-verification route for that situation. Ufriends' slip service is for customers who can provide the required BVN details.
Can I print a BVN slip online? Ufriends provides available printable formats. Review the live options and price before submitting.
Can I correct a wrong name during printing? No. Printing reproduces the available record; use the proper BVN modification process for incorrect data.
What if one bank shows a different name? Verify the central BVN result first. If it is correct, ask that bank to refresh its local customer profile.
Should I create another BVN? No. Retrieve or correct the existing BVN through an authorised process.
How do I get Ufriends support? Use the authenticated order history and the official support channel linked from your dashboard so the request remains traceable.
